Karthik — I pulled the bundle and correlated with internal autoscaler and pool logs. Preliminary findings: 

- We observed a transient pool eviction in us-west-2 between 2028-01-11T20:21:12Z and 2028-01-11T20:28:37Z (7m 25s). The observed 503 spike aligns with repeated reconnect attempts and a shortfall of ready replicas while the pool recovered.
- Classification: partial availability impact; I recommend S2 (degraded availability) per our SLA criteria.
- Credit recommendation: proportional remediation — prorated credit for the 7m 25s window applied to the monthly committed units tied to their reserved capacity. Exact dollar amount requires plugging into the billing formula; I can produce the minutes/percentage and raw metrics for Finance.
- Next steps: I will prepare an RCA draft (root cause, why eviction occurred, and three mitigations) and share within 72 hours.

I'll attach the filtered log segment and a short timeline once I'm done. For now: validated eligible window (UTC start/end above) and S2 recommendation.

—Marcus Lin
